source_snapshot.test_set: AMD CPU RAS -PCIe ACS Fatal Error
source_snapshot.procedure: Requires an ACS-capable NIC, fixed tuple 0:0:1/core3/port0, errortype 4, immediate reset, reboot and post-boot dmesg under literal AER/severity/SyncFlood settings.
source_snapshot.criteria: Fatal error must appear in BERT dmesg after warm reset, OS must report within undefined timeout and lspci must show ACS capability.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; broad live dmesg/SEL collection cannot prove fresh BERT correlation, ACS locus or the reset event, and it includes unrelated PCIe error terms.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED; adds ACS-capability and recovery gates but does not define which function/port must expose ACS, errortype-4 authority, BERT freshness or per-slot tuple coverage.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Cannot capture the immediate reset boundary or target-correlate a fresh BERT record.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Improves operator gating but treats lspci ACS presence and post-boot dmesg as sufficient without control-state, source-ID and stale-record exclusion.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Baseline OCP row 66 preserves per-slot tuple and fresh BERT/CPER evidence; this PCIe variant still needs its own physical slot/device/upstream-port identity.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Fatal reset acceptance requires signed topology, ACS capability/control proof and one fresh durable record tied to the injected source.

original_test_intent: For every required PCIe slot, inject one approved ACS fatal condition into the exact ACS-capable NIC path, verify the intended immediate warm reset and a fresh target-correlated BERT/CPER record after boot, then prove NIC, link and system recovery.
original_method: Map each physical slot/NIC and upstream hierarchy to BDF and NBIO/core/port; identify the ACS-capable component and required ACS control bits with lspci -vv; validate tool/errortype 4; snapshot BERT/CPER identity and BIOS/AER policy; under independent OOB console inject one target once; timestamp reset/firmware/boot; decode the new PCIe CPER section and source identifiers; verify link/device/driver health and restore settings before another slot.
manual_activity: The FAE installs and maps the ACS-capable NIC path, approves the exact ACS function/control and fatal policy, performs one injection under OOB capture and owns warm-reset, boot and device recovery.
required_inputs: Physical slot/NIC serial/FW/driver/BDF/upstream hierarchy to socket/die/NBIO/core/port map for every target
Exact ACS-capable function and required ACS capability/control bits from lspci -vv, not mere keyword presence
AMD tool/spec version/hash/license and proof pcieerror errortype 4 selects the intended ACS fatal stimulus
Decoded 7EF6030, AER masks, DPC, Reset After Sync-Flood and SyncFlood policy
Pre-event BERT inventory, expected new CPER section/source/severity fields and stale-record exclusion method
Supported OS/kernel, reset/firmware/boot deadlines, aborts, OOB recovery, RDIMM relevance and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated backed-up SUT with independent BMC/serial console and known-good boot/reimage path
Power/ESD-safe NIC installation; verify live physical/BDF/NBIO mapping and ACS controls before injection
Quiesce traffic and exclude boot or management-critical endpoints unless explicit recovery is approved
Inject once on one mapped target; abort on wrong source, missing reset, boot loop, stale/missing BERT, link/device loss or unexpected escalation
No automatic retry/reset; preserve durable evidence and restore/diff BIOS/HDT/AER/ACS/DPC/SyncFlood state
agent_execution_scope: Validate topology, ACS capability/control locus, tool semantics, fatal policy, BERT freshness and recovery plan
Collect read-only lspci/AER/ACS, OOB console, BERT/CPER, BMC/UEFI, boot, link/device and post-health evidence
Do not install NIC, choose tuple/control/outcome, change BIOS/HDT, inject/reset/rebind/retry/recover or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve per-slot ACS function, tuple and errortype semantics
Supervise one injection and platform recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A live broad grep cannot survive immediate reset, identify the ACS-capable function or prove a fresh target-correlated BERT/CPER record.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After signed topology, ACS-control and errortype approval, inject one mapped target under OOB capture and correlate a new decoded BERT/CPER PCIe record through warm reset, boot and link recovery.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Tuple 0:0:1/core3/port0, errortype 4, immediate reset, BERT dmesg, ACS lspci check, slot 1~N and 30/60-minute values remain preserved but unresolved values are gated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run one topology-mapped ACS-fatal stimulus per approved slot with durable OOB timing, fresh decoded CPER correlation and complete NIC/link recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds ACS locus/control proof, per-slot mapping, flag authority, stale-record exclusion, decoded CPER/source correlation, deadlines and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: lspci capability presence plus generic post-boot dmesg cannot prove the selected ACS path generated the new fatal record.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong ACS target or policy may reset the host, lose the boot/management NIC, corrupt active traffic or prevent reboot.

project_override_considerations: If ACS exists only on an upstream function or required controls cannot be safely enabled, retain execution as pending rather than treating endpoint lspci text as sufficient. A previously retained BERT record cannot satisfy freshness.
expected_evidence: Exact platform, NIC, physical slot, BDF hierarchy and NBIO/core/port identity
lspci -vv ACS capability/control locus plus decoded BIOS/AER policy
Tool/spec and one complete errortype-4 injection transcript
OOB timestamp of immediate reset, firmware and boot
Fresh decoded BERT/CPER PCIe section with target/source/severity correlation
Restored NIC/link/driver/system health, configuration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Slot 1~N is represented by one fixed tuple; the source does not say which endpoint/upstream function must be ACS-capable or which controls are required, nor prove errortype 4. Literal severity is undecoded, BERT freshness/source fields and deadlines are absent, RHEL 2022 and RDIMM relevance are ambiguous, and DeepSeek's live generic logs cannot span reset.

blocked_analysis.analysis: ACS fatal/reset/BERT intent is clear. Engineering can supply the target matrix, flag authority and durable oracle, so static review completes while execution remains gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 65 Wistron-System RAS-00785-V002: provide per-slot NIC/BDF/upstream-to-NBIO/core/port mapping; identify the exact ACS-capable function and required ACS control bits; prove errortype=4 ACS-fatal semantics and justify ECC RDIMM; decode/approve 7EF6030, masks, DPC/SyncFlood/reset policy; define fresh target-correlated BERT/CPER fields, supported OS/kernel, reset/boot timeout, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Replaces a keyword-level ACS check and volatile generic log with function-specific ACS controls, a signed target path and fresh decoded BERT/CPER correlation across the fatal reset.
independent_technical_reasoning: ACS capability may reside on an upstream bridge rather than the NIC function, and capability presence does not show that the control relevant to the test is enabled. Because the host resets immediately, pre-reset OS buffers are unreliable; a new CPER record must be distinguished from retained BERT data and tied to the injected hierarchy. Reusing one NBIO tuple cannot demonstrate slot 1~N coverage without a physical-to-logical matrix.
